problem: Generic channel search cannot escape the interleaved A/B contacts of an authoritative compact USB-C footprint, while synthetic fixed dogbones can collide with shield and NPTH geometry.
rootCause: Routing began from nominal connector centers without a package-specific escape pattern or a real-KiCad per-net transaction gate.
solution: Stagger the duplicated DP/DN via escapes from transformed pad coordinates, reserve distinct inner-layer trunks, enforce production drill minima, exclude plane-backed GND from channel search, and merge only nets that independently reduce ratsnest count with zero real KiCad violations.

evidence.cc2Repair: Move the resistor escape away from the 3V3 via field and reserve an In2.Cu lane above the VUSB trunk.
evidence.usbDnRepair: Route USB_DN before explicit GND: escape A7/B7 left through 0.5/0.3 mm vias, merge at x=7.2, and cross In2.Cu at y=19 above CC2 and 3V3.
